decision_scope: Engineering admission of the exact freeze-02 prospective pilot only. Root must independently publish the frozen registration and issue START; this receipt does not start a model or grant model qualification.
confirmed: The V9 task definitions and prompt/message constructors, V8 admission, V7 atomic session and V4 actual native/resource evaluator are inherited at the pinned source commit. No original experiment protocol or previous negative result is rewritten.

Exactly three fixed Rust-node qualification tasks precede sixteen main cells in the unchanged V9 rotated order. Eligibility requires fresh three-of-three correct public/native/resource and terminal-hidden results under the same freeze; reference controls and READY bootstraps are not model qualification.

All four main arms request the same model alias and common fixed budgets. Three attempts mean one initial response and at most two public repairs. No arm-specific token, wall or retry budget branch was found.

Initial messages expose original source, the complete public node catalogue, language/interface rules and public cases. Reference code and hidden cases are not added to benchmark prompts. Only the explicit reference-control worker imports reference answers.

Every repair uses the complete previous response and actual public feedback with the original captured query. Rejected edits are not rebased, merged, partially installed or repaired by the host. Hidden evaluation is terminal for the cell on success or failure and cannot enter repair feedback.

First terminal qualification failure stops the qualification and leaves main unstarted. Ordinary main-task public or hidden failures remain recorded; protocol, identity, infrastructure or global-budget failures stop further main cells. There is no automatic model substitution, rerun or prompt search.

Source, tool, pilot and prompt identities are checked against the freeze, including after evaluation before accepting correctness and before issuing the qualification ticket. Identity failure at that gate does not leave qualification_eligible true.

The second frozen controls set contains nineteen actual successful reference public/native/resource/hidden evaluations and nineteen malformed-response rejections in the exact registered order. Independent reading verified all thirty-eight worker cleanup receipts, all native/reference result fields and persisted compiled artifact bytes.

The independently reviewed transport rejects unregistered events, tool use, malformed or incomplete usage and uncertain cleanup. Observed usage survives post-transport evidence failures as a lower bound; indeterminate launches are not reported as zero-cost nonlaunches.

Two pre-registration READY calls remain separately disclosed. One has complete input/output/cache fields; the header-only call has unknown usage decomposition. The registration explicitly precedes benchmark task generation, not every historical service request.
The withdrawn first freeze, its exact original runner/protocol/tests, prior controls and review findings are preserved. They confer no eligibility for this second freeze.

registered_tasks.order: Exact current V9 support.cells order: listed qualification order, four main arms rotated by task index.

resolved_pre_freeze_findings: Move each model working directory outside source and evidence trees.
Stop main on infrastructure_failure, including hidden artifact identity drift.
Express the retry rule as three total attempts rather than three repairs.
Recheck frozen identities after evaluation and before setting qualification eligibility.
Retain launched or indeterminate requests and observed costs even if EVENTS/transport receipt persistence fails; an incomplete total remains unknown.
limitations: This is a source-and-record review with bounded controls, not a compiler soundness proof, a security audit of every dependency or trusted-hardware attestation.
The fixed tasks are previously used finite synthetic tasks; neither unseen real workloads nor broad C/C++ migration productivity is established.

A common requested alias and local CLI hash do not attest identical provider weights, route, configuration, sampling or cache state. Provider cache and backend behavior remain uncontrolled; repeated outcomes are not guaranteed.
User configuration, rules and hooks remain in effect. A fresh empty working directory and no observed tool events do not prove physical inability to read files or a hermetic provider context.

Token/context limits are rejection thresholds on reported usage after a call. There is no provider tokenizer capacity proof or pre-generation hard output-token guarantee. Reasoning-inclusive charges are conservative and may overlap raw output-token counts.
All nineteen reference controls and nineteen dummy controls are engineering checks, not model successes. The model still has to earn fresh three-of-three qualification before main.

The prior header-only bootstrap has incomplete detailed cost and both bootstrap wall times are unavailable. Human labor, complete service lifecycle costs, pricing and statistical advantage are not measured.
The receipt permits one registered pilot under the stated stop rule only. It is not permission to tune after failed qualification, change a frozen interface or select a favorable rerun.
A successful final pilot would provide a scoped observation on these tasks and this visible runtime, not a general agent-productivity or published superiority result.
